value.title: Chill Out
value.synopsis: Agetarou's next lesson opens his eyes to the world of chillin'. But his quest for the ideal chill might spell the end to his DJ career!

value.title: Episode 7
value.synopsis: Japan's coolest freelance writer is moved by Agetarou's funkiness. Will his words inspire the young man to lead the new generation of DJ talent?

value.title: Episode 8
value.synopsis: Agetarou learns about EDM when a Korean DJ heats up one cold dance floor. When a whole crowd wants yakiniku, what's a tonkatsu DJ to do?

value.title: Episode 9
value.synopsis: Agetarou gets some sweet and spicy inspiration from a pair of cute girl DJs... but his own flavor mix still has a long way to go!

value.title: Episode 10
value.synopsis: The "Newcomer Killer" is out to kill his Agetarou's career! Lured from the safety of his home turf in Shibuya, can he handle Ikebukuro's hip-hop heat?!

value.title: Lard City, Part 1
value.synopsis: Despondent over his mentor's lack of popularity, Agetarou plots a way to throw Oily into the DJ spotlight!

value.title: Lard City, Part 2
value.synopsis: DJ Oily's Lard City event is ready to heat up! But will the biggest snow in a century force the guests to cancel and leave the party cold?
